heading: Bidayaat
heroTitle: What remains of the beginnings of the Saudi art movement, in one place
heroBody: Press articles, photographs, documents, and catalogues gathered from artists, their families, and community associations — digitised, with their sources documented. Search across all of it from a single field.
searchPlaceholder: Search for an artist, artwork, article, photograph…

contribute.title: Have material from this period?
contribute.body: The archive is gathered from artists, their families, associations, and private collections. Ownership stays with the holder, the source is recorded with every item, and the owner sets the access level.
